- **Member-communication pagination FIX — accurate count via countOnly (2026-07-13):** Symptom: user saw only 25 emails w/ no working Next (should be hundreds). ROOT CAUSE: Mailjet's `/message` list endpoint returns `Total` == the current page `Count` (NOT the grand total), so `has_next = offset+page_size < total` was always False. FIX: (1) `has_next` no longer trusts `Total` — computed from a full-page heuristic `any(page_count >= page_size)` per email (robust, self-correcting; at most one trailing empty page when total is an exact multiple of page_size). (2) NEW `mailjet_api.get_message_count(email, client=None)` uses Mailjet's global `countOnly=1` param (`client.message.get(filters={"ContactAlt":email,"countOnly":1})`) → returns the REAL grand total (Data empty + Count=total); returns `None` if countOnly was ignored (Data non-empty) so the view degrades gracefully. `MemberCommunicationView._from_api` now calls get_message_count per email (wrapped in try/except → None on API error), sums for `total_count` (None if any unknown), and uses the heuristic for has_next. `get_context_data` sets `total_known` + `page_row_count`; template shows "{total} messages total" + "Showing X–Y of N" when known, else "{n} on this page" + "Page {p}". page_size stays 25. **GOTCHAS:** (a) Mailjet `/message` `Total` is unreliable (== page Count) — never use it for pagination; use countOnly for totals + full-page heuristic for has_next. (b) view now makes 2 API calls per email per page (count + page) — countOnly is lightweight. (c) view tests that hit `_from_api` (ANYMAIL creds set) MUST patch BOTH `get_messages_for_email` AND `get_message_count` or they make a real HTTP call. 4 new tests (get_message_count countonly/ignored/empty + view Next-works-when-count-unknown); email_tracking suite 43 tests. **Full suite 1813 pass / 17 skip / 0 fail (~121s)** (1 flaky `test_calculate_meeting_attendance` failed once under -n auto, passed on re-run).

(2) **Pagination** — `MemberCommunicationView.page_size=25`; `mailjet_api.get_messages_for_email(email, limit=25, offset=0, client=None)` now returns a DICT `{"data":[...], "total":int, "count":int}` (was a bare list — BREAKING, updated tests) using Mailjet `Limit`/`Offset`; view reads `?page=`, computes offset, builds Prev/Next controls + "Showing X–Y of N" using `base_query` (GET minus page) + `has_previous`/`has_next` (from per-email `offset+page_size < total`). wired in [config/urls.py](config/urls.py) as `path("email-tracking/", include(..., namespace="email_tracking"))`. **Template** [templates/email_tracking/member_communication.html](thetatauCMT/templates/email_tracking/member_communication.html) (extends base.html; GET form + `{{ form.media }}`; table Date/Subject/Recipient/Status badge/Opens-Clicks/History; vanilla-JS `fetch()` expands history rows via `data-history-url`; JS in `{% block javascript %}{{ block.super }}` SIBLING of content). **Profile link:** [templates/users/user_profile.html](thetatauCMT/templates/users/user_profile.html) natoff-only sensitive section (`can_view_sensitive`) now has a "View email communication" button → `email_tracking:member_communication?member=<pk>`. **GOTCHAS:** (a) Django templates FORBID variable/attribute access starting with underscore — enrichment dict keys on the Mailjet message dicts MUST be non-underscore (`recipient_email`/`tracked`/`subject_display`/`status_class`, NOT `_recipient` etc.) or `TemplateSyntaxError: Variables and attributes may not begin with underscores`. - **Mailjet open/read-receipt tracking — NEW app `email_tracking` (2026-07-13):** herald 0.3.0 has NO open tracking (SentNotification status = Pending/Success/Failed/UserDisabled only; `_send` builds EmailMultiAlternatives + mail.send()). Solution uses Mailjet's NATIVE tracking via **django-anymail 13.0 (already installed)** — NO custom pixel. **New app** [thetatauCMT/email_tracking/](thetatauCMT/email_tracking/) (in LOCAL_APPS before email_signals; migration 0001). Models: `TrackedEmail` (unique message_id+recipient; aggregates open_count/first_opened_at/last_opened_at/click_count/delivered_at/bounced_at/complained_at/unsubscribed_at/reject_reason/last_status; FK user + FK herald.SentNotification), `EmailTrackingEvent` (append-only raw event log). **Signals** [email_tracking/signals.py](thetatauCMT/email_tracking/signals.py) wired in apps.ready(): (1) anymail `post_send` → create TrackedEmail per recipient keyed on Mailjet MessageID (`status.recipients[email].message_id`); resolves user by metadata user_id OR email/email_school OR allauth EmailAddress. (2) anymail `tracking` (from webhook) → append EmailTrackingEvent + roll state onto TrackedEmail (`_apply_event_to_tracked`, uses `anymail.signals.EventType`); get_or_create TrackedEmail if webhook arrives w/o prior post_send. (3) `post_save` on herald.SentNotification (STATUS_SUCCESS) → link recent TrackedEmail rows (subject+recipient, within EMAIL_TRACKING_LINK_WINDOW_MINUTES=10) back to the notification (herald doesn't expose ESP msg id, and post_send fires BEFORE herald saves SentNotification, so link from the herald side). **ALL 3 receivers are DEFENSIVE (try/except, never raise)** — anymail RE-RAISES post_send receiver exceptions (would break sends) and the webhook dispatches `tracking` via signal.send (raise → HTTP500 → Mailjet retries forever). **Tracking enabled on EVERY email** via `core.email.TrackingEmailBackendMixin` (sets message.track_opens/track_clicks from settings.EMAIL_TRACK_OPENS/CLICKS default True → Mailjet TrackOpens/TrackClicks) → new `TrackingMailjetBackend(TrackingEmailBackendMixin, EmailBackend)` + `MyHijackBackend` now includes the mixin (MRO verified: mixin before EmailBackend). production.py EMAIL_BACKEND → `core.email.TrackingMailjetBackend`; ANYMAIL gets `WEBHOOK_SECRET` from env `ANYMAIL_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (only set if non-empty — anymail `len(None)` crashes on None). **Webhook receiver**: `path("anymail/", include("anymail.urls"))` in [config/urls.py](config/urls.py) (unconditional; include() works even though anymail only in INSTALLED_APPS in production — package is pip-importable). Endpoint `/anymail/mailjet/tracking/` (reverse name `anymail:mailjet_tracking_webhook`). **Mgmt cmd** `python manage.py register_mailjet_webhook [--url URL] [--list]` ([email_tracking/management/commands/register_mailjet_webhook.py](thetatauCMT/email_tracking/management/commands/register_mailjet_webhook.py)) uses `requests` (already a dep) to POST event types (sent/open/click/bounce/blocked/spam/unsub) to Mailjet REST `/v3/REST/eventcallbackurl`. **Anonymizer** [anonymizer/email_tracking.py](anonymizer/email_tracking.py) `register_clean` both models (recipient email = PII, mirrors herald SentNotification). Admin read-only (TrackedEmail w/ EmailTrackingEventInline). Docs [docs/email_tracking_setup.md](docs/email_tracking_setup.md). **GOTCHAS:** (a) `anymail.signals.AnymailTrackingEvent(**kwargs)` — event_type is KEYWORD-only (`AnymailTrackingEvent(event_type=..., message_id=..., recipient=..., timestamp=...)`), NOT positional (real webhook passes kwargs; my test helper initially passed positionally → TypeError). (b) When updating TrackedEmail via `save(update_fields=...)`, EVERY changed field (incl. reject_reason) MUST be in update_fields or the change is silently dropped. (c) `makemigrations` on this repo regenerates a stray `herald/migrations/0006_alter_..._id` in SITE-PACKAGES (DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD=BigAutoField vs herald ships only 0001-0005) — my migration deps point at shipped `("herald","0005_auto_20180516_1755")`, NOT the ephemeral 0006; delete the stray 0006 before migrate. Baseline `makemigrations --check` ALREADY reports pending 3rd-party/local migrations (herald/report_builder/email_signals/survey/contact_sync/finances/jobs) — pre-existing noise, email_tracking is NOT among them. (d) locmem test backend does NOT fire anymail signals → tests simulate via `post_send.send()`/`tracking.send()` w/ AnymailStatus+AnymailRecipientStatus / AnymailTrackingEvent. 17 tests in [email_tracking/tests/](thetatauCMT/email_tracking/tests/) (backend mixin, post_send, tracking open/click/bounce/stub, herald link, webhook end-to-end + basic-auth reject/accept). **Full suite after: 1787 pass, 17 skip, 0 fail (~130s).** check + anonymize_db --check_only pass.
- **Ritual Proficiency navbar-break fix (2026-07-13):** [templates/forms/ritual_proficiency_form.html](thetatauCMT/templates/forms/ritual_proficiency_form.html) had `{% block javascript %}...{% endblock javascript %}` **nested INSIDE `{% block content %}`** (endblock content came last). Django renders a nested block BOTH inline (where it sits in content) AND at the parent's placeholder → base.html's javascript block (which the child pulls via `{{ block.super }}`) rendered TWICE, so `bootstrap.bundle.min.js` loaded twice → Bootstrap's data-api dropdown/offcanvas click handlers double-registered → every navbar dropdown toggled open-then-shut (looked "broken"). **Fix:** moved `{% endblock content %}` up so `javascript` is a SIBLING of `content` (correct pattern used by every other template). **Rule:** child templates must NEVER put `{% block javascript %}`/`{% block css %}`/`{% block modal %}` inside `{% block content %}` — base.html renders those in separate locations. Audited all 15 templates w/ `block javascript` + all `block css`/`block modal`; ritual form was the ONLY offender (others correctly do `{% endblock content %}` THEN `{% block javascript %}`).

New `Nomination` fields (migration 0003): `last_activity` + `last_contacted` DateTimeFields (null). **Flow change** [nominations/flows.py](thetatauCMT/nominations/flows.py): REMOVED the `follow_up_end` End node; the `follow_up` Handler now `.Next(this.follow_up_wait)` where `follow_up_wait = flow.Function(this.follow_up_placeholder, task_loader=lambda flow_task, task: task).Next(this.send_consent_request)` — a PARKED "awaiting follow-up" node (the codebase's `flow.Function` "wait-for-management-command" pattern, mirroring users.MemberUpdateFlow.delay/placeholder + DisciplinaryProcessFlow). `follow_up_placeholder` decorated `@method_decorator(flow.flow_func)` does `activation.prepare(); activation.done()`. This makes the flow CYCLIC: send_consent_request -> nominee_consent -> check_consent -> follow_up -> follow_up_wait -> (re-contact) -> send_consent_request... (viewflow allows loops). `send_consent_request_func` now also stamps `last_contacted=last_activity=now` (save update_fields) after issuing token+email; `mark_follow_up` stamps `last_activity`. Consent view `_apply` ([nominations/views.py](thetatauCMT/nominations/views.py)) stamps `last_activity` on nominee response (added `from django.utils import timezone`). **Re-contact hook** [nominations/services.py](thetatauCMT/nominations/services.py): `recontact_nomination(nomination)` finds the parked `follow_up_wait` Task (status NEW) and calls `NominationFlow.follow_up_wait.run(task)` (the `flow.Function` advance API; run(task) -> task_loader -> placeholder -> done -> activate_next loops back to send_consent_request which rotates token + re-emails + restamps last_contacted -> nominee_consent). Returns True/False. flow_func decorator handles its own lock+atomic so no manual lock mgmt. Also `is_awaiting_follow_up(nomination)` (parked follow_up_wait NEW exists) and `nominations_awaiting_follow_up(before=None)` (query for VWI-12 daily command: `Nomination.objects.filter(pk__in=<follow_up_wait NEW process_ids>, finished__isnull=True[, last_contacted__lte=before])` — Nomination.pk == Task.process_id since Process subclass). **viewflow flow.Function advance recipe (REUSABLE):** parked Function task is status NEW (FuncActivation.activate creates+saves but does NOT perform); advance via `FlowNode.run(task)` or `FlowNode.run(process.get_task(FlowNode))` (viewflow Process HAS `get_task(flow_task, status=None)`); define the func `@method_decorator(flow.flow_func) def placeholder(self, activation, task): activation.prepare(); activation.done()` + node `flow.Function(this.placeholder, task_loader=lambda flow_task, task: task)`. **Tests** [nominations/tests/test_follow_up.py](thetatauCMT/nominations/tests/test_follow_up.py) (10): block enforced + only-that-nominee, initial contact stamps timestamps, follow_up_later marks awaiting + stamps activity, recontact reissues token+email + restamps last_contacted, recontact returns to awaiting-response (has_active_consent_task True / is_awaiting_follow_up False), recontact no-op when not parked, recontact repeats every cycle, nominations_awaiting_follow_up lists-only-parked + before-cutoff. **Updated** VWI-1 [test_flows.py](thetatauCMT/nominations/tests/test_flows.py) (`test_follow_up_later_parks_awaiting_follow_up`, node list `follow_up_end`->`follow_up_wait`) + VWI-3 [test_consent.py](thetatauCMT/nominations/tests/test_consent.py) (`test_follow_up_later_parks_awaiting_follow_up`) since follow_up no longer ends. **Full suite after: 1719 passed, 17 skipped, 0 failed (~95s)** (nominations 52 tests). system check + anonymize_db --check_only pass. - **Volunteer Nomination VWI-2 — Recommendation form as Start view (2026-07-12):** Mostly completed the Start view/form already built in VWI-1; refinements + view tests. `NominationForm` ([nominations/forms.py](thetatauCMT/nominations/forms.py)): module const `NOT_INTERESTED_MESSAGE = "This person has indicated they are not interested."`; clean() blocks a fresh recommendation ONLY when `Nomination.objects.filter(nominee=nominee, not_interested=True).exists()` (raises the exact message) — multiple submissions for the same nominee are otherwise allowed & retained (even after failed vetting; rejected/denied do NOT block). On valid POST the `NominationCreateView` (VWI-1) starts the process and advances to `nominee_consent`. **New tests** [nominations/tests/test_views.py](thetatauCMT/nominations/tests/test_views.py) (7) drive the ACTUAL Start view over HTTP; test_models.py block test now asserts `form.errors["__all__"] == [NOT_INTERESTED_MESSAGE]`. **viewflow Start-view HTTP POST test recipe (REUSABLE, important):** (1) `reverse("viewflow:<app>:<proc>:start")` MUST be called INSIDE a db-enabled test, NOT at module top (viewflow URL reverse touches DB → pytest-django "Database access not allowed" at collection). (2) POST body MUST include the start management form field `"_viewflow_activation-started": <datetime str>` (form `viewflow.forms.ActivationDataForm`, prefix `_viewflow_activation`, field `started` HiddenInput required=True) — the Start node's activation is `ManagedStartViewActivation`. (3) A SUCCESSFUL start returns **302** (redirect to next task) — do NOT `follow=True`: the next task (`nominee_consent`) is owned by the NOMINEE, so following redirects the logged-in nominator into a 403. Assert 302 + check `Nomination.objects`/`Task` directly. (4) An INVALID/blocked form re-renders **200** (no redirect) → assert message in `response.content.decode()` + count unchanged. (5) `auto_login_user()` (conftest) handles RMPSignMiddleware; start view is LoginRequiredMixin only (any member can recommend), no `.Permission()` on the start node. MultiSelectField POSTed as a list; checkbox `discussed_with_nominee="on"`. **Full suite after: 1694 passed, 17 skipped, 0 failed (~96s)** (VWI-1's 20 + VWI-2's 7 = 27 nominations tests).

National officers (`collect_national_officer_contacts`) leave it empty (no chapter mailbox). `ChapterDetailView.get_context_data` ([chapters/views.py](thetatauCMT/chapters/views.py)) builds `email_list` from officer emails + region email + `chapter.get_generic_chapter_emails()`, deduped/blanks-dropped. `RegionOfficerView` ([regions/views.py](thetatauCMT/regions/views.py)) builds `email_list` from `self.filter.qs.values_list("email","chapter_id","current_roles")` + per-officer generics via a `chapter_map`, and exposes `email_generic_map` (personal email → "; ".join(generics)) in context; the CSV export (`get()`) appends a "Generic Officer Email" column (`columns.names()+["Generic Officer Email"]`, each data row `list(row)+[email_generic_map.get(row[4],"")]`; row[4]=email idx in UserTable). RegionAdvisorView unchanged (advisors have no role mailbox). Tests: 2 in [contact_sync/tests/test_officers.py](thetatauCMT/contact_sync/tests/test_officers.py) (generic in `emails`; multi-role covers all), 1 in [chapters/tests/test_models.py](thetatauCMT/chapters/tests/test_models.py) (`generic_email_for_role`), 1 in [chapters/tests/test_views.py](thetatauCMT/chapters/tests/test_views.py) (detail email_list), 2 in [regions/tests/test_views.py](thetatauCMT/regions/tests/test_views.py) (officers email_list+`email_generic_map`; CSV column). **Test gotcha (ChapterFactory collision):** since `ChapterFactory` uses `django_get_or_create=("name",)` from the small `GREEK_ABR` pool, a view test that creates a chapter while a viewer chapter already exists (auto_login_user) can get the viewer's chapter back and DROP the `email_regent=` kwarg — so set generic email fields AFTER creation (`chapter.email_regent="..."; chapter.save(update_fields=["email_regent"])`) to make email-presence assertions deterministic.

- **NME-program "Request Revisions" button (2026-07-12):** On `PledgeProgramListView` (`/forms/pledge-program-list/`, natoff-gated), the `PledgeProgramTable` ([forms/tables.py](thetatauCMT/forms/tables.py)) gained a FIRST column `notify` (`TemplateColumn` template `forms/pledge_program_notify_button.html`, `orderable=False`, listed first in `Meta.fields`) that renders a "Request Revisions" button per submitted program (only when `record.pk` truthy — `pk` is `F("process__pk")`, None for not-yet-submitted chapters). New natoff view `pledge_program_request_revision(request, process_pk)` in [forms/views.py](thetatauCMT/forms/views.py) (`@group_required("natoff")` + `@require_POST`) looks up the `PledgeProgramProcess`, emails the chapter's exec board via `chapter.council_emails()` using `GenericEmail` (cc central office + `chapter.region.email`, addressee `{chapter.full_name} Officers`) with message "Comments have been added to your NME program, please revise and resubmit." + the Google-doc NME link (`chapter.nme_file_id`) + `process.approval_comments`; redirects to `HTTP_REFERER` (fallback `forms:pledge_program_list`) with a Django message. URL name `forms:pledge_program_request_revision` (`<int:process_pk>`). **CSRF gotcha (verified):** `pledgeprogram_list.html` renders the table MANUALLY (does NOT use `{% render_table %}`), and django_tables2 2.7.5 `TemplateColumn.render` only attaches request/csrf context when rendered via `{% render_table %}` (`context = getattr(table, "context", Context())`). So a `{% csrf_token %}` INSIDE the column would be empty. Solution: the button is a plain `<button data-notify-url data-chapter>`; a single hidden `<form id="pledge-program-notify-form" method="post">{% csrf_token %}</form>` + a delegated click handler at the page bottom sets `form.action` and submits (POST + CSRF from page context, confirm() dialog, no nested-form conflict with the embedded filter form). The button template guards `{% url %}` inside `{% if record.pk %}` so None pks never hit NoReverseMatch. `record.pk`/`record.chapter_name` resolve via dict-key lookup (rows are dicts). 4 tests in [forms/tests/test_views.py](thetatauCMT/forms/tests/test_views.py) (sends-email via `patch("thetatauCMT.forms.views.GenericEmail")`, requires-natoff→302, GET→405, full-page render shows button+per-row URL). **Test email pattern here: patch the `GenericEmail` class (not `mail.outbox`)** — herald doesn't populate outbox. `ChapterFactory` sets `email` so `council_emails()` is non-empty (includes `chapter.email` via `get_generic_chapter_emails`). Forms suite: 479 pass, 10 skip.

- **Anonymizer (dj_anonymizer) realigned (2026-07-11):** `anonymizer/` de-identifies the staging DB (loaded only in local.py+staging.py INSTALLED_APPS; run via `podman exec thetataucmt_local_django python manage.py anonymize_db [--check_only]`, mirrored in [backup.sh](backup.sh)). Validate with `--check_only` (raises `LookupError` listing every unregistered model; also validates fields at import). **Registration modes:** `register_skip([M])`=leave data (non-PII), `register_clean([(M,AnonymBase)])`=delete all rows (secrets/raw-PII), `register_anonym([(M,Anon)])`=fake fields (anonym_fields + `exclude_fields` + auto FK/O2O/M2M/pk MUST exactly equal the model's concrete `Field` set). **LOADER BUG FOUND+FIXED:** dj_anonymizer imports `anonymizer/<app.name>.py`, but local apps are dotted (`thetatauCMT.users`) while files are short (`users.py`) → 17 local files were NEVER imported → real `anonymize_db` failed with ~80 unregistered models (local PII was NOT being de-identified at all). Fix: [anonymizer/base.py](anonymizer/base.py) (always imported first) now has `_autoload_local_anonymizers()` that `importlib.import_module(f"anonymizer.{name}")` for every sibling `.py` whose basename is NOT an installed `app.name` (third-party files like address/herald load via dj_anonymizer's own app.name path — importing twice raises "already declared"). Self-adapting: a new local app's `anonymizer/<app>.py` is auto-loaded once created; until then `--check_only` fails loudly. **Coverage added:** new files [anonymizer/attendance.py](anonymizer/attendance.py) (skip AttendanceRecord+AttendanceStatusTransition; clean MatchQueueItem = raw uploaded emails/names) + [anonymizer/contact_sync.py](anonymizer/contact_sync.py) (clean UserContactSyncToken = encrypted OAuth secrets + account_email). Updated: users.py (skip UserTag; UserAnonym anonymizes `profile_picture`=fake.file_path, excludes `unsubscribe_categories`), forms.py (removed `StatusChange.employer` anonymization — it's now an FK to new `Employer` → auto-excluded; skip Employer+OtherSchool; new RitualProficiencyAnonym fakes `notes`), jobs.py (JobPostingBanAnonym fakes `reason`), events.py (skip CalendarFeedSubscription). `core.models.TimeStampedModel` adds exactly `created`+`modified`. **NOTE:** anonymizer modules are only imported by the anonymize_db command, never during tests/app runtime, so these changes don't affect the test suite.
- **Test-suite SPEEDUP (2026-07-11):** Profiled with cProfile (`podman exec thetataucmt_local_django python -m cProfile -o /tmp/t.pstats -m pytest <subset> -n 0`; read via `pstats ... sort_stats('tottime').print_stats(30)`). **Root bottleneck was WhiteNoise, NOT the DB or password hashing** (PBKDF2 was already MD5 in test.py). `whitenoise.middleware.WhiteNoiseMiddleware` re-walks the entire `STATIC_ROOT` (`staticfiles/`, ~900+ files) every time the Django test client rebuilds the middleware stack (once per request-issuing test), so `posix.stat` under `whitenoise.scantree` was ~43% of total time (105s of 236s on the users+tasks subset). **Fix:** [config/settings/test.py](config/settings/test.py) now strips it: `MIDDLEWARE = [mw for mw in MIDDLEWARE if "whitenoise" not in mw]`. Tests use default `StaticFilesStorage` so `{% static %}` still yields plain `/static/...` URLs. **Result: users+tasks subset 236.5s → 22.0s (~10.7x) serially; FULL SUITE 426.8s (7m06s) → 105.7s (1m45s) = ~4.0x wall, still 1617 pass / 17 skip / 0 fail.** No coverage lost. Re-profiled: new top frames are healthy/spread (psycopg2 execute, module import stat/compile, gc) — no further single bottleneck.
- **Second profile (2026-07-11) — factory bloat is NOT a wall-time bottleneck (measured, reverted):** Profiled again after WhiteNoise. Top cumtime looked like factory creation (19.8s) + model saves (21.8s); the obvious suspect was `ChapterFactory` post-generating `random.randint(0,15)` curricula/chapter + `UserFactory.major` creating a curricula/user (the `.github/prompts/speed-up-tests.prompt.md` audit flags these too). **Made them opt-in as an experiment → NO wall-time change** (full suite 105.7s→108.6s = noise; users+tasks serial 21.96s→21.34s = noise). Local Postgres inserts are cheap; the cProfile cumtime was call-overhead inflation, not real wall time. **Reverted all factory changes** (kept the changeset focused on the measured WhiteNoise win) — classic "profiler keeps you honest" (guessed a bottleneck, measurement disproved it). **DISCOVERED latent bug (NOT fixed, out of scope):** [forms/notifications.py](thetatauCMT/forms/notifications.py) `EmailPledgeConfirmation.__init__` does `pledge_form.user.major.major` unguarded, but `User.major` is a nullable FK (`on_delete=SET_NULL`) → AttributeError when major is None. Only surfaces if a pledge's major curricula is deleted. Fix if ever touched: `... if pledge_form.user.major else ""`. (Templates rollbook_pdf/majors_dropdown are None-safe via Django var resolution.)
- **ChapterFactory-collision flakiness fixed (2026-07-11):** Profiling surfaced a Faker-seed flaky test — **pytest-randomly is NOT installed so Faker is unseeded (different data every process)**; `ChapterFactory()` draws `name` from the small `GREEK_ABR` pool with `django_get_or_create=("name",)`, so a bare `ChapterFactory()` intermittently returns the caller's OWN chapter and breaks "other chapter" assertions. Added `_other_chapter(than_chapter)` helper in [tasks/tests/test_views.py](thetatauCMT/tasks/tests/test_views.py) (`next(n for n in GREEK_ABR.values() if n != than_chapter.name)` → `ChapterFactory(name=...)`) used by the 4 tasks list tests (`incomplete_includes_task_completed_only_by_other_chapter`, `complete_shows_only_this_chapter_completions`, `all_filter_does_not_duplicate`, `complete_link_annotation_points_to_this_chapter`). Verified 0/20 failures across fresh seeds. **Reusable pattern for any "distinct 2nd chapter" test in this repo.**
- **Prior full-suite state (2026-07-11, pre-speedup): 1617 pass, 17 skip, 0 fail in ~7m06s** (all 10 CI failures already fixed — see "Test suite flakiness fixes" below).
- **Test suite flakiness fixes (2026-07-11):** GitHub Actions showed 10 fails; root causes + fixes: (1) `core/tests/test_urls_resolve.py::test_url_resolves[events:update[pk]]` — `events:update` is date+slug now; param changed to `{"year":2023,"month":1,"day":1,"event_slug":"test"}`. (2) `chapters/tests/test_views.py::test_chapter_detail_view` — chapter_detail.html redesigned (no more "{name} in the {region} Region"); assert `chapter.name` + `f"{region} Region"` separately. (3) `events/tests/test_models.py::test_calculate_meeting_attendance` — events dated -15d..-5d straddled the Jun/Jul spring→fall semester boundary so `semester_encompass_start_end_date()` counted a varying event subset; added `@pytest.mark.freeze_time("2026-04-15 12:00:00")` (mid-spring, all events one semester → deterministic 0.38). (4) **7 `tasks/tests/test_views.py` `?date=today` tests** — **TIME_ZONE=America/Phoenix (UTC-7) + USE_TZ**: django-filter `DateRangeFilter` "today" filters on `timezone.now()` (**UTC** day) but the tests date tasks with `datetime.date.today()` (**local** day); during Phoenix evening (UTC past midnight) they differ and the filter matches nothing (`assert <TaskDate> in []`). Added module const `FROZEN_NOON_UTC="2026-05-15 12:00:00"` + `@pytest.mark.freeze_time(FROZEN_NOON_UTC)` on every `date=today` list test (incl. the 3 new archive list tests). Noon UTC = 05:00 Phoenix (same calendar day) and freezegun collapses `date.today()`==`now()`. (5) Un-skipped 2 long-skipped flaky tests `test_chapter_list_view_chapter_officer` / `test_chapter_list_view_natoff` with `@freeze_time("2026-05-15 12:00:00")` — they're robust because the fixture's RMP (dated frozen-today) satisfies `RiskManagement.user_signed_this_semester` (spring window) so `RMPSignMiddleware` never redirects, and `ChapterListView` is LoginRequiredMixin only (officer branch just messages). **pytest-randomly and pytest-repeat are NOT installed** (so `-p randomly` ERRORS — use plain default run; Faker global state is the only ordering-based variability, distributed by `-n auto`). Pattern for future date flakiness: `@pytest.mark.freeze_time("YYYY-MM-15 12:00:00")` (mid-month noon-UTC) makes local(Phoenix)==UTC and avoids month/term boundaries.

Officer collection in [contact_sync/officers.py](thetatauCMT/contact_sync/officers.py). **`_chapter_abbr()` now returns `.upper()`** so the display prefix is always upper-case even when `chapter.greek` is stored lower-case.

- **Contact-sync sample-data seed (2026-07):** `podman exec thetataucmt_local_django python manage.py seed_contact_sync_examples [--chapters N] [--skip-chapters] [--skip-national]` in [contact_sync/management/commands/seed_contact_sync_examples.py](thetatauCMT/contact_sync/management/commands/seed_contact_sync_examples.py). Idempotent (via `get_or_create` on the tagged email) — 110 chapter officers (22 active chapters × 5 roles) + 18 national officers on first run in local dev; 0 new users on rerun. **Never deletes data.** Every seeded user gets **both** `email` (@contact-sync-seed.thetatau.local) and `email_school` (@<chapter>.seed-university.edu) so the QA'ing officer can visually confirm we push both to Google/Microsoft/vCard. Seed users have an active `UserStatusChange` running through 2100 and a `UserRoleChange` covering today. **Test gotcha:** `_ensure_active_status` and `_ensure_role` explicitly bump `user.current_roles`/`current_status` because the model's pre-save signal only appends the role when `start <= TOMORROW < end` and doesn't refresh across DB-reload boundaries. **Idempotence gotcha:** counts show "updated: 110" on rerun because some fields (`chapter_id`, `phone_number`) round-trip via FK descriptors and always look "changed" to my `changed_fields` diff — no duplicates are created; the counter is cosmetic. Test data has **badge_number = 900_000_000..999_999_999** to stay out of the way of real records.
- **Contact-sync token encryption + push (2026-07 — unchanged foundations):** OAuth tokens live in `UserContactSyncToken` (unique on `(user, provider)`) with `access_token`/`refresh_token` encrypted at rest via `cryptography.fernet.Fernet` keyed on `sha256(settings.SECRET_KEY)` — see [contact_sync/models.py](thetatauCMT/contact_sync/models.py). `set_refresh_token("")` is a no-op so Google's "no refresh_token on refresh" response never clobbers a stored value. Providers in [contact_sync/providers/](thetatauCMT/contact_sync/providers/) register themselves via `@register` decorator; each provider is only exposed in the UI when both its `CONTACT_SYNC_<PROVIDER>_CLIENT_ID` and `_CLIENT_SECRET` settings are set. Microsoft's `authorize_url`/`token_url` are `@property` because the tenant (`CONTACT_SYNC_MICROSOFT_TENANT`, default `"common"`) is runtime-configurable. Both providers push **both** emails per contact via `OfficerContact.emails` (deduped case-insensitively, primary email first). URLs at `/contact-sync/` in [thetatauCMT/contact_sync/urls.py](thetatauCMT/contact_sync/urls.py). Setup guide in [docs/contact_sync_setup.md](docs/contact_sync_setup.md). 76 tests total in [thetatauCMT/contact_sync/tests/](thetatauCMT/contact_sync/tests/) (54 original + 22 national/auto-sync/seed). **Test gotchas:** `UserRoleChange` has NO `chapter` field (chapter comes from `user.chapter`), so factory calls are `UserRoleChangeFactory.create(user=..., role=..., current=True)` — `current=True` post-generation hook straddles today; and the provider `import requests` MUST be at module top so `mock.patch("...providers.google.requests.get")` resolves.

- **Self-submission blocking on peer-review forms (2026-07):** Officers can no longer submit forms about themselves for forms that must be initiated by someone else. Applies to: `PrematureAlumnusForm`, `ConventionForm` (delegate + alternate), `AlumniExclusionForm`, `OSMForm`, `DisciplinaryForm1`, `CollectionReferralForm`, `ReturnStudentForm`, `RitualProficiencyForm`, `StatusChangeSelectForm`, `RoleChangeSelectForm`, `RoleChangeNationalSelectForm`. Two-layer defense: (1) [`UserAutocomplete`](thetatauCMT/users/views.py) filters out `self.request.user` when the forward config includes `exclude_self=true`; (2) each form accepts `request_user` via `__init__` and raises `ValidationError` from a `clean_<field>` method when the picked user equals the requester. `_reject_self(form, field_name, request_user, label=None)` helper + `SELF_SUBMIT_FORBIDDEN_MSG` constant live at the top of [thetatauCMT/forms/forms.py](thetatauCMT/forms/forms.py). Views inject `request_user` via `get_form_kwargs()` override on `PrematureAlumnusCreateView` / `ConventionCreateView` / `OSMCreateView` / `AlumniExclusionCreateView` / `DisciplinaryCreateView` / `ReturnStudentCreateView` / `RitualProficiencyCreateView`; `CollectionReferralFormView` adds `get_collection_kwargs()` (MultiFormsView convention); `RoleChangeView` / `RoleChangeNationalView` (both `extra_views.ModelFormSetView`) override `get_form_kwargs()` (returned dict is passed into the formset's `form_kwargs`); `StatusChangeSelectView` puts `request_user` into `get_formset_kwargs()["form_kwargs"]` and additionally excludes self from the `actives()` queryset on `get_formset` / `get_context_data`; `StatusChangeView.initial_info()` also excludes self as a safety net so any stale session data cannot slip a self-status-change through. **RoleChange forms special case:** existing role rows are rendered with all fields `disabled=True` and only the last extra row is editable — `clean_user` skips the self-check when `self.fields["user"].disabled` so the officer can still edit other rows on the page when their own name already appears as an existing officer. Info banners added to 11 templates: [officer.html](thetatauCMT/templates/forms/officer.html), [officer_national.html](thetatauCMT/templates/forms/officer_national.html), [prematurealumnus_form.html](thetatauCMT/templates/forms/prematurealumnus_form.html), [convention_form.html](thetatauCMT/templates/forms/convention_form.html), [alumniexclusion_form.html](thetatauCMT/templates/forms/alumniexclusion_form.html), [osm_form.html](thetatauCMT/templates/forms/osm_form.html), [disciplinary_form.html](thetatauCMT/templates/forms/disciplinary_form.html), [collection.html](thetatauCMT/templates/forms/collection.html), [returnstudent_form.html](thetatauCMT/templates/forms/returnstudent_form.html), [ritual_proficiency_form.html](thetatauCMT/templates/forms/ritual_proficiency_form.html), [status-select.html](thetatauCMT/templates/forms/status-select.html). 13 new tests in [thetatauCMT/forms/tests/test_views.py](thetatauCMT/forms/tests/test_views.py) exercise both layers. **Test caveat:** two existing `test_return_student_form_clean_user_*` tests use `Form.__new__(Form)` to skip `__init__`; they had to be updated to set `f.request_user = None` explicitly, otherwise `clean_user` blows up on the missing attribute. New tests that construct forms via `__new__` follow the same pattern.
- **Regional/National dashboard — Recruitment & Careers tab (2026-07):** New 4th tab (`value="recruitment"`) in `RegionDashboard` at [thetatauCMT/regions/dashboard.py](thetatauCMT/regions/dashboard.py) with 4 panels: `top-recruiting-chapters` (top-10 initiations, AY-scoped), `retention-by-chapter` (grouped-by-region vertical bars with `1 - depledges/pnms` where PNMs>0; drops zero-PNM chapters instead of showing 100%), `majors-breakdown` (top-15 majors across active members in scope, AY-independent), `graduation-employer-cloud` (plotly `Treemap` sized by graduate count on `StatusChange.reason="graduate"` per `Employer.name`, AY-scoped). Two new helpers: `_horizontal_bar_top_n(rows, label_key, value_key, x_label, theme, top_n=10, region_key=None)` (largest bar on top — plotly draws horizontal bars bottom→top so we `.iloc[::-1]` before rendering; optional per-bar `region_key` coloring uses `REGION_PALETTE`) and `_treemap_from_rows(rows, label_key, value_key, theme)`. No wordcloud library is installed in the container — `Treemap` is the closest plotly-native equivalent. `graduation_employer_cloud` filters on `StatusChange.date_start__gte/lt` (AY window, `DateField`) with `employer__isnull=False`. `retention_by_chapter` mirrors the KPI card's PNM formula (`UserStatusChange.status="pnm"` with `start__gte/lt` and `distinct` user_id) but partitioned by `user__chapter__name`; hovers show `%{y:.1f}%`. All 4 callbacks added to `test_ay_dependent_graph_callbacks_return_figure` parametrize list except `majors_breakdown` which has its own `test_majors_breakdown_returns_figure` (AY-independent, 2-arg signature). 8 new helper unit tests in [thetatauCMT/regions/tests/test_dashboard.py](thetatauCMT/regions/tests/test_dashboard.py). All 44 dashboard tests pass.

- **Public member profile page (2026-07):** New [UserProfileView](thetatauCMT/users/views.py) at URL name `users:profile` (`profile/<username>/`) — accessible to any authenticated member (`LoginRequiredMixin` only, no natoff gate). URL name `users:info` (`memberinfo/<username>`) kept as an alias to the same view so existing reverse() calls keep working. `UserDetailView` module-level alias kept for any external import. Template [thetatauCMT/templates/users/user_profile.html](thetatauCMT/templates/users/user_profile.html) shows: header card (photo, name/preferred name/nickname/pronouns, chapter+badge, current status, current role badges, charter-member badge) with owner-only "Edit My Info" button and superuser-only "Admin" button; status banners for deceased/expelled/resigned/probation/no-contact (with `RESIGNED_STATUSES = {"resigned","resignedCC"}`, `EXPELLED_STATUSES = {"expelled","pendexpul"}`, `DISCIPLINE_STATUSES = {"suspended","probation"}` in the view); Basics card (initiation date+roll, graduation year, degree, major, class year, employer+position); Contact card (email, school email, phone, address); Officer Roles history (from `user.roles.all()`); External Organizations (from `user.orgs.all()`); Ritual Proficiency table (from `user.ritual_proficiency.all()`); NATOFF-only sensitive block (only rendered when `can_view_sensitive = is_natoff or is_superuser`) containing Notes (`UserNoteTable`), Member Submissions (`SubmissionTable`), Job Postings authored by the member, and Task completions (`TaskChapter.filter(created_by=target)`). New `ProfilePictureUpdateView` at `users:profile_picture` (`myinfo/profile-picture/`) is a `LoginRequiredMixin` `UpdateView` acting on `request.user` — supports POST `clear=1` to delete the file and null out the FK. New `User.profile_picture = ImageField(upload_to="profile_pictures/%Y/%m/", blank=True, null=True)` + `historicaluser.profile_picture` as `CharField(max_length=100)` (simple_history's ImageField mirror). Migration [users/migrations/0037_profile_picture.py](thetatauCMT/users/migrations/0037_profile_picture.py). **Reverse OneToOne quirk:** accessing `user.initiation` when no `Initiation` row exists raises `Initiation.DoesNotExist` — `getattr(user, "initiation", None)` does NOT catch it (getattr only catches AttributeError). The view wraps it in `try/except Exception` and stores `initiation=None` in context. **UserTable link change:** [thetatauCMT/users/tables.py](thetatauCMT/users/tables.py) now unconditionally links the name column to `users:profile` (was `admin:users_user_change` for admins, `users:info` for natoff, plain text otherwise) — flows across the entire app now route through the profile page. Backend admin still reachable via the "Admin" button on the profile itself when the viewer is superuser. Five viewflow `process_data.html` templates ([resignation](thetatauCMT/templates/forms/resignation/process_data.html), [prematurealumnus](thetatauCMT/templates/forms/prematurealumnus/process_data.html), [returnstudent](thetatauCMT/templates/forms/returnstudent/process_data.html), [disciplinaryprocess](thetatauCMT/templates/forms/disciplinaryprocess/process_data.html), [osm](thetatauCMT/templates/forms/osm/process_data.html)) now link user name to `users:profile` instead of `admin:users_user_change`. 7 new tests added in [users/tests/test_views.py](thetatauCMT/users/tests/test_views.py) — regular member sees profile (200) without natoff sections, natoff sees "Add Note" button, unauth redirects, owner sees "Edit My Info", superuser sees "Admin" (needs `@override_settings(DEBUG=True)` because of RequireSuperuser2FAMiddleware), profile-picture view returns 200 for owner and redirects for unauth. Old `test_user_detail_view_denied_regular_user` removed (view is no longer natoff-gated).
- **Categorized unsubscribe (2026-07):** New [thetatauCMT/users/unsubscribe.py](thetatauCMT/users/unsubscribe.py) hosts `UNSUBSCRIBE_CATEGORIES` (list of `UnsubscribeCategory(slug, label, description)` — currently `grad_anniversary`, `velocitas`, `birthday`) plus helpers `get_category`, `is_unsubscribed(user, slug)` (True if `no_contact` OR global `unsubscribe_email` OR slug in `user.unsubscribe_categories`), and `set_category_unsubscribed`. New `User.unsubscribe_categories = ArrayField(CharField(64), default=list, blank=True)` on both `user` and `historicaluser` (migration `users/migrations/0036_unsubscribe_categories.py`). `make_unsubscribe_token(user, category=None)` embeds category into the signed token; unknown slugs are dropped. `_unsubscribe_footer(user, category=None)` in [thetatauCMT/users/notifications.py](thetatauCMT/users/notifications.py) names the mailing list ("Unsubscribe from Graduation Anniversary" vs generic "Manage email preferences") when given a category. `MemberEmail.from_config(..., unsubscribe=True, category=SLUG)` propagates it. `UnsubscribeConfirmView` (GET/POST) in [thetatauCMT/users/views.py](thetatauCMT/users/views.py) + template [thetatauCMT/templates/users/unsubscribe_confirm.html](thetatauCMT/templates/users/unsubscribe_confirm.html) now render one checkbox per category + an "Unsubscribe from all optional Theta Tau email" toggle (flips `unsubscribe_email`); the category from the token is pre-checked and badged "from this email". POST preserves any unknown/legacy slugs already stored on `user.unsubscribe_categories` so an unrelated save doesn't discard them. `grad_anniversary_email` management command's `_grad_queryset` now additionally excludes `user__unsubscribe_categories__contains=["grad_anniversary"]`, `_send_preview` refuses when `is_unsubscribed(user, "grad_anniversary")`, and both call sites pass `category="grad_anniversary"` to `MemberEmail.from_config`. 9 new tests in [thetatauCMT/users/tests/test_views.py](thetatauCMT/users/tests/test_views.py) cover the flow (all 187 users-app tests still pass).
- **StatusChange.new_school_other data preservation (2026-07):** Migration [0043_otherschool.py](thetatauCMT/forms/migrations/0043_otherschool.py) rewritten to the same rename→addFK→populate→drop pattern as `employer` (was a naive `AlterField` that would silently drop or fail to cast any text values captured between 0042 and 0043). `RunPython populate_new_school_other_fk` normalizes each `new_school_other_old` string (strip + whitespace collapse + trailing punctuation), case-folds for a dedup key, and creates one `OtherSchool` per unique key. **Skips** values whose normalized key matches an existing `Chapter.school` — those should be picked from the New School dropdown, not created as OtherSchool records. Post-migration fuzzy cleanup via `podman exec thetataucmt_local_django python manage.py merge_duplicate_other_schools [--threshold 0.90] [--dry-run] [--yes]` in [forms/management/commands/merge_duplicate_other_schools.py](thetatauCMT/forms/management/commands/merge_duplicate_other_schools.py). Two-pass sweep: (1) any `OtherSchool.name` that normalizes to an existing `Chapter.school` → moves affected `StatusChange` rows to `new_school_id` (the FK to Chapter) and deletes the OtherSchool; (2) fuzzy `difflib.SequenceMatcher` merges within remaining OtherSchools, keeping the longest name as canonical. All changes wrapped in `transaction.atomic()`. Interactive confirmation unless `--yes`.
- **StatusChange.employer autocomplete + normalization (2026-07):** `StatusChange.employer` is now a nullable FK to a new `Employer` model (`unique` name, `TimeStampedModel`, admin-registered) instead of a free-form `CharField`. `CSMTForm.employer` and `GraduateForm.employer` use `ModelChoiceField` + `dal.autocomplete.ModelSelect2(url="forms:employer-autocomplete")` — same officer-gated `post()` pattern as `OtherSchoolAutocomplete`. Migration [0044_employer.py](thetatauCMT/forms/migrations/0044_employer.py) does a data-preserving swap: `RenameField employer→employer_old`, `AddField employer FK`, `RunPython` builds an `Employer` per distinct normalized name (case-fold + whitespace collapse + trailing punctuation and legal-suffix stripping like `Inc/LLC/Corp/Co/Ltd/PLC/LLP/LP/GmbH`), then `RemoveField employer_old`. Post-migration fuzzy cleanup via `podman exec thetataucmt_local_django python manage.py merge_duplicate_employers [--threshold 0.90] [--dry-run] [--yes]` in [thetatauCMT/forms/management/commands/merge_duplicate_employers.py](thetatauCMT/forms/management/commands/merge_duplicate_employers.py) — uses `difflib.SequenceMatcher` on the same normalized form, keeps the longest name as canonical, repoints affected `StatusChange` rows inside a `transaction.atomic()`. `StatusChangeResource` now exports `employer__name`. `EmployerFactory` (`django_get_or_create=("name",)`) added to [forms/tests/factories.py](thetatauCMT/forms/tests/factories.py); three `test_models.py` tests were switched from `employer="Test Employer"` strings to `Employer.objects.create(...)` instances. `status.html`'s ajaxError handler now also surfaces employer autocomplete rejections in the same alert div.
- **StatusChange transfer to non-chapter school (2026-07):** Officers reporting a transfer can now record schools without a Theta Tau chapter. New model [OtherSchool](thetatauCMT/forms/models.py) (unique `name`, `TimeStampedModel`) tracks these; `StatusChange.new_school_other` is a nullable FK to `OtherSchool` (`related_name="transfers"`). `OtherSchool.clean()` rejects any name that matches an existing `Chapter.school` (case-insensitive). `CSMTForm` now uses `SchoolModelChoiceField` for `new_school` (renders `Chapter.school` instead of chapter name, excludes `active=False`) and a `dal.autocomplete.ModelSelect2` widget for `new_school_other` pointing at `forms:otherschool-autocomplete` (new URL). Form `clean()` requires exactly one of `new_school` / `new_school_other` when `reason="transfer"` and re-checks the picked `OtherSchool` name against `Chapter.school`. Autocomplete view `OtherSchoolAutocomplete` in [thetatauCMT/forms/views.py](thetatauCMT/forms/views.py) is officer-gated (`is_officer_group or is_superuser`); overrides `post()` to return `JsonResponse({"error": ...}, status=400)` for empty text or chapter-collision names (Django test client re-raises `create_object` exceptions, so use `post()` — NOT `create_object` — for user-visible validation). Migration [0043_otherschool.py](thetatauCMT/forms/migrations/0043_otherschool.py) creates the model + FK. `status.html` renders both `{{ form.media }}` and `{{ csmt_formset.media }}` so the DAL widget's JS/CSS loads on the status page. `StatusChangeResource` exports `new_school_other__name`. `OtherSchoolAdmin` registered.
- **Chapter Activity feed (2026-07):** New "All Activities" one-stop view at `chapters/<slug>/activity/` (name `chapters:activity`) plus `chapters/activity/` redirect for the current user's chapter (`chapters:activity_redirect`). Nav entry added at the top of the Activity dropdown in [thetatauCMT/templates/base.html](thetatauCMT/templates/base.html), gated on `request.is_officer or request.is_nat_officer or user.is_superuser`. Access on the view itself is enforced in `ChapterActivityView.dispatch`: superuser OR `natoff` group OR (`officer` group AND `user.current_chapter.pk == chapter.pk`); anyone else is redirected to `home` with an error. Collector lives in [thetatauCMT/chapters/activity.py](thetatauCMT/chapters/activity.py) — `iter_chapter_activity(chapter, start_dt, end_dt)` returns a newest-first list of `ActivityItem(when, display_date, category, label, title, actor, url)` from Events, Submissions, Task completions (`TaskChapter`), Ballot votes (`BallotComplete`), Trainings (completed only), and 19 form models (Initiation, Depledge, StatusChange, ChapterReport, HSEducation, RiskManagement, Audit, Pledge, PledgeProgram, Convention, OSM, DisciplinaryProcess, CollectionReferral, Bylaws, AlumniExclusion, RitualProficiency, ResignationProcess, PrematureAlumnus, ReturnStudent). Deliberately excludes notes, invoices, scores. Model imports are lazy inside collectors to avoid app-loading cycles. Date-vs-datetime handled per-field via `field.get_internal_type()`. URLs use `_safe_reverse` (catches `NoReverseMatch`) with `forms:landing` fallback. Window picker query param `?window=` supports `3m`, `6m` (default), `12m`, `current_term`, `previous_term`, `academic_year` (uses `core.models.semester_encompass_start_end_date`, `academic_encompass_start_end_date`); category picker `?category=` filters to one of `Form/Event/Task/Submission/Ballot/Training`. Pagination: `ChapterActivityView.per_page = 50`; view uses `django.core.paginator.Paginator` on the in-memory list, `?page=` in querystring, `PageNotAnInteger` → page 1, `EmptyPage` → last page. Context includes `page_obj`, `paginator`, `is_paginated`, `filtered_count`, and `base_query` (querystring minus `page`) for the pagination links. Template [thetatauCMT/templates/chapters/chapter_activity.html](thetatauCMT/templates/chapters/chapter_activity.html) uses theme-aware Bootstrap 5.3 classes (`bg-body-tertiary`, `text-body-secondary`, plain `<thead>` — NEVER `table-light`/`bg-light`/`bg-dark` in this app) and per-category `.activity-badge-{event,task,form,submission,ballot,training}` classes defined in [thetatauCMT/static/css/project.css](thetatauCMT/static/css/project.css) with light + `[data-bs-theme="dark"]` palettes. `counts_list` (pre-built list of `(cat, count)` tuples in view) avoids needing a custom `get_item` template filter. Tests in [thetatauCMT/chapters/tests/test_activity.py](thetatauCMT/chapters/tests/test_activity.py) — **any superuser test path MUST use `@override_settings(DEBUG=True)`** or `RequireSuperuser2FAMiddleware` redirects to `/setup/` (302). Pagination assertions must derive expected page-2 size from `paginator.count`/`paginator.num_pages` — the test DB (`--reuse-db`) can leak an extra Event row into a chapter created via `ChapterFactory` because `ChapterFactory.Meta.django_get_or_create = ("name",)` and chapter names are drawn from a small `GREEK_ABR` pool.
- **Address widget revamp (2026-07):** Replaced Google-autocomplete `AddressWidget` + `DuplicateAddressField(AddressField)` with a typed-components `ComponentAddressWidget`/`ComponentAddressField(MultiValueField)` across all 4 form usages: [thetatauCMT/users/forms.py](thetatauCMT/users/forms.py) `UserForm`, [thetatauCMT/chapters/forms.py](thetatauCMT/chapters/forms.py) `ChapterForm`, [thetatauCMT/forms/forms.py](thetatauCMT/forms/forms.py) `PledgeUserBase` and `DisciplinaryForm`, AND the Django admin: [thetatauCMT/users/admin.py](thetatauCMT/users/admin.py) `MyUserChangeForm` and new `ChapterAdminForm` in [thetatauCMT/chapters/admin.py](thetatauCMT/chapters/admin.py). Widget renders 5 inputs (street / city / state / zip / country) — state & country are TEXT INPUTS backed by shared `<datalist>`s (US states + CA provinces + UK regions) so all three regions work without country-conditional JS. Choices/reverse maps in [core/choices.py](core/choices.py). Widget template at [thetatauCMT/templates/core/component_address_widget.html](thetatauCMT/templates/core/component_address_widget.html). When `settings.GOOGLE_API_KEY` is a real key (not "TESTING") the widget also renders a Google Places search box that fills the 5 fields client-side via [thetatauCMT/static/core/js/component_address_autocomplete.js](thetatauCMT/static/core/js/component_address_autocomplete.js); that search input is NOT part of form submission. Existing `AddressField` FK to `address.Address` kept intact (no data migration). Backing helper `get_or_create_address(street, city, state, postal_code, country, state_code)` in [core/address.py](core/address.py). `compress()` normalizes state input: 2-letter US/CA codes → full name (+ persists code); UK regions → code; other countries → free text. Dedup rule changed: field returns the OLDEST matching `Address` by id (no auto-merge on save). Explicit merging via `podman exec thetataucmt_local_django python manage.py merge_duplicate_addresses [--dry-run]`. Incomplete-address triage via `podman exec thetataucmt_local_django python manage.py find_incomplete_addresses [--samples N] [--csv PATH] [--repair]` — classifies rows missing `street_number`+`route` into recoverable (raw starts with a street-like segment matched by `^\s*(?:\d+|[A-Za-z]+\s+\d)`), locality-only, or empty-raw; `--repair` only touches the recoverable set. Both commands live under [thetatauCMT/configs/management/commands/](thetatauCMT/configs/management/commands/) because `core/` is NOT a Django app (not in `LOCAL_APPS`) — management commands placed under `core/management/commands/` will not be discovered. `clean_address` methods that called `fix_address()` (Google Geocoder) were removed from all 4 forms — the new field returns a valid `Address` or `None`. `fix_address`, `fix_duplicate_address`, `deduplicate`, `update_address` in [core/address.py](core/address.py) are preserved for the still-used `scripts/address_fixes.py` and `scripts/address_deduplicate.py`.
  - **Critical fix (must persist):** `ComponentAddressWidget.decompress()` MUST resolve integer PKs to `Address` instances (`Address.objects.select_related("locality__state__country").get(pk=value)`). `ModelForm` passes an FK's PK integer as the field's initial value, NOT the related instance — without this branch the widget renders empty inputs on GET even though the underlying record is populated correctly. Bug symptom: save works (POST returns 302) but the detail form and admin page show blank address fields on next load.
  - AddressAdmin ([core/admin.py](core/admin.py)) list_display now includes both `user` and `chapter` helpers, with `UnidentifiedNoUserListFilter` (user presence) and a sibling `ChapterPresenceListFilter` (chapter presence). Search fields include `chapter__name`.
- Users app: `UserTag` model + `User.tags` M2M (blank, admin-only autocomplete). Registered in `MyUserAdmin` via `autocomplete_fields=("tags",)` and Personal info fieldset after `officer`. Migration `0035_usertag_alter_historicaluser_class_year_and_more.py`.
- **Tasks app — archive/retire old TaskDates (2026-07-11):** New `TaskDate.archived` (BooleanField "No Longer Needed", default False, db_index) + `archived_on` (DateTimeField null) + `archived_reason` (CharField blank); migration [0008_taskdate_archived_taskdate_archived_on_and_more.py](thetatauCMT/tasks/migrations/0008_taskdate_archived_taskdate_archived_on_and_more.py). Model helpers `archive(reason="")` / `unarchive()` (both `save(update_fields=...)`). **Root bug fixed:** `mark_complete` + `TypeFieldFilteredChapterAdd.form_valid` call `incomplete_dates_for_task_chapter(...).first()` (oldest date in window `[today-2*days_advance, today+days_advance]`), so a lingering OLD incomplete date got auto-completed instead of the current one. Now ALL task querysets exclude `archived=True`: `Task.all_dates_for_task_chapter`, `Task.incomplete_dates_for_task_chapter`, `TaskDate.incomplete_dates_for_chapter` (HomeView + ical todos + RD-monthly notif), `..._next_month`, `dates_for_next_month`, `..._past`, and `dates_for_chapter(cls, chapter, include_archived=False)`. `TaskCompleteView.form_valid` refuses to complete an archived date (adds error msg, `form_invalid`) + `get_context_data` adds `is_archived` (warning banner in [task_complete.html](thetatauCMT/templates/tasks/task_complete.html)). `TaskListView.get_queryset` now bases on `dates_for_chapter(chapter, include_archived=True)` so the new `archived` ChoiceFilter (`0`=hide default / `1`=only / `A`=all) in [tasks/filters.py](thetatauCMT/tasks/filters.py) `filter_archived` controls visibility; `_build_request_get` defaults `archived=0`; `InlineField("archived")` added to [tasks/forms.py](thetatauCMT/tasks/forms.py) `TaskListFormHelper`. Admin ([tasks/admin.py](thetatauCMT/tasks/admin.py)): `archived` in `TaskDateAdmin.list_display`/`list_filter` + actions `mark_no_longer_needed`/`restore_dates` + `archived` on `TaskDateInline`. `RegionTaskView` ([regions/views.py](thetatauCMT/regions/views.py)) base qs now `TaskDate.objects.filter(archived=False)`. **Mgmt command** `podman exec thetataucmt_local_django python manage.py archive_old_task_dates [--before YYYY-MM-DD | --older-than-days N] [--task NAME] [--reason ...] [--dry-run]` in [tasks/management/commands/archive_old_task_dates.py](thetatauCMT/tasks/management/commands/archive_old_task_dates.py) — default cutoff = current academic-year start (`academic_encompass_start_end_date()[0]`); bulk `qs.update(archived=True, archived_on=now, archived_reason=...)`. Tests: tasks suite now **67 pass, 1 skip** (was 49/1) — archive model tests in [test_models.py](thetatauCMT/tasks/tests/test_models.py), list/complete view tests in [test_views.py](thetatauCMT/tasks/tests/test_views.py), new [test_commands.py](thetatauCMT/tasks/tests/test_commands.py) (5). **Test gotcha:** `incomplete_dates_for_chapter_past` window starts at the academic-year start (July → very short past window); use `academic_encompass_start_end_date()[0].date()` as the "past" date, NOT `today-10d`, or the pre-archive assertion is flaky in early fall. **Pre-existing unrelated failure:** `core/tests/test_urls_resolve.py::test_url_resolves[events:update[pk]]` — stale `("events:update", {"pk": 1})` param; `events:update` is now date+slug (`event_slug`). Not caused by tasks work.
- Tasks app (earlier): 43 pass, 1 skipped. `TaskListView` filtering rewritten. `filter_complete` now uses `Exists(TaskChapter.filter(task=OuterRef, chapter=user.current_chapter))` instead of `Case(When(chapters__chapter=chapter))`, which incorrectly joined all `TaskChapter` rows and duplicated/misclassified rows when other chapters completed the same `TaskDate`. `TaskListView.get_queryset` annotates once with `complete_link=Subquery(...pk)` and `is_complete=Exists(...)`, and no longer re-runs the filter or rebuilds the table in `get_context_data`. `table_pagination = {"per_page": 40}` on the view keeps prior pagination. See [thetatauCMT/tasks/filters.py](thetatauCMT/tasks/filters.py), [thetatauCMT/tasks/views.py](thetatauCMT/tasks/views.py), [thetatauCMT/tasks/tables.py](thetatauCMT/tasks/tables.py).
- Jobs app: full moderation workflow. Job fields: `deleted*`, `reported*`, `approved*`, all with reason. New `JobPostingBan` model bars a user from posting jobs. Migrations `0002`–`0005`. `get_live_jobs(request=None)` hides `reported=True, approved=False` from non-natoff; owner still sees their own reported/deleted postings via the "My Jobs" branch of `JobListView`. Report/Approve/Delete/Ban POST endpoints all require a reason, are natoff-gated (except Report), and store audit fields (`*_by`, `*_at`, `*_reason`). Approved postings hide Report/Delete/Ban buttons. `JobCreateView.dispatch` redirects banned users to the list with an error; job list template hides the "Add Job" button when `user_is_banned` is true. `JobCopyView` clones an existing job into the create form for the owner (or superuser). `JobPostingBan` is registered in admin (`ban.reason` can be edited to lift).
  - **Jobs notifications (2026-07):** New [thetatauCMT/jobs/notifications.py](thetatauCMT/jobs/notifications.py) hosts 4 herald-registered `EmailNotification` classes: `JobCreatedNotification` (recipient = `Config['JOBS_CREATION_EMAIL']` — CKEditor HTML stripped, split on `[\s,;]+`, case-insensitive dedup), `JobDeletedNotification` (Central Office), `JobBannedNotification` (Central Office, includes `affected_count`), `JobSearchMatchNotification` (owner's email + `emailaddress_set` + `email_school`). `JobCreateView.form_valid` auto-approves postings by natoff/superuser (`approved=True`, `approved_by=user`, `approved_reason="Auto-approved: posted by National Officer or superuser."`) and then calls `notify_job_created(job)` which sends the creation email plus any `JobSearch` whose `notification == "immediate"` and matches. `JobDeleteView` and `JobBanUserView` call `notify_job_deleted` / `notify_job_banned` inline (no re-notify when the row was already deleted/banned). `notify_matching_searches(job_qs, frequency)` skips searches with **no active filter** (empty ANDs/ORs/NOTs) so an empty-filter search does not blanket-notify. Templates: [job_created.html](thetatauCMT/templates/herald/html/job_created.html) / [job_deleted.html](thetatauCMT/templates/herald/html/job_deleted.html) / [job_banned.html](thetatauCMT/templates/herald/html/job_banned.html) / [job_search_match.html](thetatauCMT/templates/herald/html/job_search_match.html), all extend `herald/html/base_email.html`. Management command `podman exec thetataucmt_local_django python manage.py job_search_notify --frequency daily|weekly|both [--since ISO]` in [thetatauCMT/jobs/management/commands/job_search_notify.py](thetatauCMT/jobs/management/commands/job_search_notify.py) uses `digest_since()` (24h for daily, 7d for weekly), filters `Job.get_live_jobs().filter(created__gte=cutoff)`, then routes matches through `notify_matching_searches`. `job_create_form.html` shows a green "auto-approved" alert when `user_is_natoff_or_superuser` is true (context flag from `JobCreateView.get_context_data`). Tests in [thetatauCMT/jobs/tests/test_notifications.py](thetatauCMT/jobs/tests/test_notifications.py) (29 tests). **JobForm quirk:** ModelForm POST tests must include `majors_specific=False` and a valid seeded `Locality.pk` for `location`, plus `country=<us_pk>` — omitting `majors_specific` or `location` yields form.errors and 200 instead of 302.
- New tests added across sections 5.1–5.8 (prompt-driven coverage improvements)
- Django 4.2.23, allauth 65.10.0, Python 3.13-slim, PostgreSQL 12
- Test command: `podman exec thetataucmt_local_django pytest --tb=no -q`
- Targeted run: `podman exec thetataucmt_local_django pytest <file> -v --tb=short`
- **Everything runs in containers** — do NOT run `manage.py`, `pytest`, or Django `check` via the local venv. Use `podman exec thetataucmt_local_django <cmd>` (compose service `django`). Container name is lowercase even when compose project is `thetatauCMT`.
- **Also: do NOT read/inspect files under `c:\workspace\.virtualenvs\...`** — even for looking at installed 3rd-party package source (e.g. `address`, `allauth`). The host venv can diverge from what's actually installed in the container. Inspect installed package source via `podman exec thetataucmt_local_django cat /path/to/site-packages/...` or `podman exec thetataucmt_local_django python -c "import pkg; print(pkg.__file__)"`.

- **Events model extensions + public-event approval workflow (2026-07 — WI-1/WI-2):** Extended [thetatauCMT/events/models.py](thetatauCMT/events/models.py) `Event` (migration [0008_event_approval_status_event_is_national_and_more.py](thetatauCMT/events/migrations/0008_event_approval_status_event_is_national_and_more.py); it also swept up a pre-existing `pledges` verbose_name="PNMs" AlterField — harmless). New fields: `is_national` (bool, only National Officers may set), `is_public` (bool), `approval_status` (TextChoices PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED, **field default APPROVED**), `parent_event` (self-FK SET_NULL, related_name="sub_events"), `region` (FK regions.Region, null), `reviewed_by` (FK user SET_NULL), `reviewed_at`, `rejection_reason`. Module-level helper `user_is_national_officer(user)` = superuser OR is_national_officer_group (natoff Django group) OR is_national_officer() (role) — **moved to [core/models.py](core/models.py) 2026-07-10** (was in events/models.py; still re-exported there for clean(); import from `core.models`; handles None/AnonymousUser). Custom manager `Event.objects = EventManager` (from `EventQuerySet`) with `.national()/.public()/.sub_events()/.top_level()/.approved()/.pending()/.rejected()/.cross_chapter_visible()/.visible_to_chapter(chapter)`. Model methods: `default_approval_status(*, is_public, created_by_national_officer, auto_approve=None)` classmethod (non-public→APPROVED; national public→APPROVED if `settings.EVENTS_AUTO_APPROVE_NATIONAL_PUBLIC` (default True) else PENDING; chapter public→PENDING), `inherit_context_from_parent()` (sub-event inherits chapter+region from parent when unset — called in `save()`), `effective_region` prop, `is_cross_chapter_visible` prop (is_public AND approved), `approve(reviewer)`/`reject(reviewer, reason="")` (set status+reviewed_by+reviewed_at, save calculate_score=False), `clean()` (blocks is_national for non-national-officer using `self._acting_user` or `created_by`; rejects self-parent). `save()` still `save(calculate_score=True, **kwargs)`; added `inherit_context_from_parent()` call (no-op without parent — scoring path untouched). Config: `EVENTS_AUTO_APPROVE_NATIONAL_PUBLIC` in [config/settings/base.py](config/settings/base.py). Form [events/forms.py](thetatauCMT/events/forms.py) `EventForm(__init__(request_user=None))` pops `is_national` for non-national officers, limits `parent_event` queryset to `visible_to_chapter`, `clean_is_national` raises for non-officers; fields added: is_public, is_national, parent_event. Views [events/views.py](thetatauCMT/events/views.py): `NationalOfficerRequiredMixin(LoginRequiredMixin)` (redirects non-natoff home via `user_is_national_officer`); `EventCreateView.get_event_kwargs` injects request_user + `forms_valid` computes approval_status/sets region/sets reviewed_by for auto-approved/strips is_national for non-natoff; `EventPendingListView`/`EventApproveView`/`EventRejectView` (POST-only, natoff-gated). URLs: `events:pending`, `events:approve`/`events:reject` (`<int:pk>`). Template [event_pending_list.html](thetatauCMT/templates/events/event_pending_list.html) (theme-aware; collapse for reject reason). Admin exposes workflow fields. Nav: "Pending Public Events" link in the National dropdown of [base.html](thetatauCMT/templates/base.html). **Test gotcha (critical):** `make_officer="chapter"` factory path can leave the user in the **natoff group** — its random initial role may be national, `UserRoleChange.save()` adds them to natoff when `is_national_officer()` is truthy, and the group is never removed after the role is corrected to a chapter role. So chapter-officer permission-denial tests MUST NOT rely on `make_officer="chapter"`; use `_make_chapter_officer(user, client)` in [events/tests/test_views.py](thetatauCMT/events/tests/test_views.py) which adds officer group, **removes natoff group**, and sets current_roles=["scribe"]. National-officer tests use `make_officer="national"` + `_make_natoff` (explicit natoff add is reliable). Create-view POST reaches `forms_valid(self, forms)` via `_process_all_forms` (omit `action`); needs picture formset management fields `form-TOTAL_FORMS/INITIAL_FORMS/MIN_NUM_FORMS/MAX_NUM_FORMS`. 35 new tests (15 model, 20 view). Events suite: 41 pass + 1 pre-existing flaky (`test_calculate_meeting_attendance`, random-date dependent — value varies run-to-run even with --create-db, scoring path untouched).

- **Events feature follow-up (2026-07-10):** (a) `Event.chapter` is now **nullable** (migration [0009_alter_event_chapter.py](thetatauCMT/events/migrations/0009_alter_event_chapter.py)) — national events are org-wide and not tied to a chapter. `save()` skips scoring when `chapter_id is None` and **forces `is_public=True` when `is_national`**; `get_event_upload_event`/`get_event_picture_upload_path` fall back to `"national"` when chapter is null. `default_approval_status` gained `is_national=` kw (national→APPROVED). (b) `parent_event` is now a **DAL autocomplete** (`autocomplete.ModelSelect2(url="events:event-autocomplete")`) in `EventForm`, not a dropdown; admin uses `autocomplete_fields=("parent_event",)` (needs `EventAdmin.search_fields=("name",)`). New `EventAutocomplete(Select2QuerySetView)` (officer-gated) scopes results by the **forwarded `is_national`**: national events look up `Event.objects.national()`, chapter events look up `Event.objects.filter(chapter=current_chapter)`; excludes forwarded `self_pk`. Templates need `{{ forms.event.media }}` (create) / `{{ form.media }}` (update) for the DAL JS/CSS. (c) Shared view helper `apply_event_workflow_fields(event, user, recompute_approval=True)` in [events/views.py](thetatauCMT/events/views.py) — national+natoff → is_public=True, chapter=None, APPROVED, reviewed_by/at; else chapter=current_chapter, region default, recompute approval. Used by both `EventCreateView.forms_valid` and the rewritten `EventUpdateView` (now `form_class=EventForm`, `get_form_kwargs` injects request_user, custom `form_valid` recomputes approval only when `{is_public,is_national} & form.changed_data` so unrelated edits don't reset approval). (d) `EventDetailView.get_object` fixed to look up by year/month/day/slug; detail + update templates show a parent-link alert (child view) and a sub-events table (parent view); [event_detail.html](thetatauCMT/templates/events/event_detail.html) rewritten. (e) `EventTable` adds `is_public` (BooleanColumn) + `parent_event` (linked to parent's update). `SubEventInline` (TabularInline, fk_name="parent_event", show_change_link) on `EventAdmin`. (f) Seed command `podman exec thetataucmt_local_django python manage.py seed_pending_national_events [--count N] [--approved M] [--reset]` in [events/management/commands/seed_pending_national_events.py](thetatauCMT/events/management/commands/seed_pending_national_events.py) — creates `[SEED] `-prefixed national events (chapter=None, is_public, PENDING) that populate the review queue; idempotent; `save(calculate_score=False)`. **Event name max_length=50** — keep seed names short. **Test gotcha:** cross-chapter visibility tests must use a chapter guaranteed distinct from the event's — `ChapterFactory` draws from a small greek `GREEK_ABR.values()` pool with `django_get_or_create=("name",)`, so a plain `.create()` can collide with the event's own chapter and break `visible_to_chapter` assertions; use `_distinct_chapter(chapter_factory, other_than)` (picks a different `GREEK_ABR` value). Events suite now 50 pass + 1 pre-existing flaky (`test_calculate_meeting_attendance`); scores/chapters/regions/core: 411 pass, 4 skip, 1 pre-existing (`test_chapter_detail_view`).

Its test [test_models.py](thetatauCMT/events/tests/test_models.py)`::test_get_absolute_url` was updated from the tuple assertion to a string/reverse assertion. `EventDetailView.get_object` now returns `.order_by("pk").first()` (raises `Http404` if none) since the date+slug URL is not unique. (2) **Pending review page** ([event_pending_list.html](thetatauCMT/templates/events/event_pending_list.html)) — event name links to `{{ event.get_absolute_url }}` with `target="_blank"`; each row now has a **details sub-row** (`<tr class="bg-body-tertiary"><td colspan="7">`) showing description/attendance/duration/virtual/host/parent/funds + "Open full details". - **Attendance module — new app (2026-07-10, WI-3..WI-6):** New Django app [thetatauCMT/attendance/](thetatauCMT/attendance/) registered in `LOCAL_APPS` (before `email_signals`) + `config/urls.py` (`attendance/`). **Models** ([attendance/models.py](thetatauCMT/attendance/models.py)): `AttendanceRecord(event FK→events.Event, user FK, status, was_active bool snapshot, chapter FK snapshot=member's HOME chapter, recorded_by, recorded_at, previous_status, transitioned_at)` unique_together(event,user); `STATUS` TextChoices signed_up/attended/no_show (default attended). `set_status(new, changed_by)` logs to append-only `AttendanceStatusTransition(record, from_status, to_status, changed_by, changed_at)` — the recommended history mechanism (never deletes the sign-up row). `member_is_active_on(user, date)` **moved 2026-07-10** → now `User.is_active_on(date)` method (users/models.py, next to `get_roles_on_date`); the shared status list is `core.models.ACTIVE_STATUSES` (also used by `Chapter.get_actives_for_date`, refactored to reference it). `is_guest` = chapter_id != event.chapter_id. **Migrations**: `0001_initial` (WI-3, status=attended only) then `0002` (WI-4: add signed_up/no_show + previous_status/transitioned_at + transition model + RunPython `migrate_existing_to_attended`). **Quorum** ([attendance/quorum.py](thetatauCMT/attendance/quorum.py)): `compute_quorum(n)` configurable via `settings.ATTENDANCE_QUORUM_RULE` (default "majority"=n//2+1; "two_thirds"; float fraction); `quorum_status(active, attended_active)` → dict with `met`. **Services** ([attendance/services.py](thetatauCMT/attendance/services.py)): `can_record_attendance(user, event)` (superuser/natoff OR officer-group member whose `current_chapter.pk == event.chapter_id`); `active_roster_for_event` (get_actives_for_date(event.date)); `parent_attendee_roster` (WI-5 default); `record_attendance(event, member, status, recorded_by)` upserts + snapshots + logs transitions. **Views** ([attendance/views.py](thetatauCMT/attendance/views.py), all under `AttendancePermissionMixin` except guest AC): `AttendanceRosterView` (GET roster+quorum+guest section), `AttendanceBulkSaveView` (POST `attendees` list + `status`; upserts checked, deletes unchecked active members of the SAME status), `AttendanceBulkUpdateView` (WI-4: `convert_all` signed_up→attended + `no_show`/`attended` overrides via set_status), `AttendanceRollupView` (WI-5 parent→per-subevent + aggregate unique/total), `GuestMemberAutocompleteView` (WI-6 privacy: officer-gated; **400 if no `chapter`**, empty if `q` shorter than `ATTENDANCE_GUEST_SEARCH_MIN_LENGTH`=2, results scoped to that chapter only with badge+grad year, capped at `ATTENDANCE_GUEST_SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS`=20 — never enumerable), `AttendanceGuestAddView`. **URLs** `attendance:roster/save/bulk_update/rollup/guest_add` — now **non-enumerable date+slug** `~<int:year>/<int:month>/<int:day>/<slug:event_slug>/[save|update|rollup|guest]/` (changed 2026-07-11 from `<int:event_pk>`) + `attendance:guest-autocomplete`. Templates [roster.html](thetatauCMT/templates/attendance/roster.html) (vanilla-JS Check All/Uncheck All + collapsed guest section with chapter→member fetch autocomplete) + [rollup.html](thetatauCMT/templates/attendance/rollup.html). Admin has `AttendanceStatusTransitionInline`. "Attendance" button added to [event_detail.html](thetatauCMT/templates/events/event_detail.html) for officers. Config settings in [base.py](config/settings/base.py): `ATTENDANCE_QUORUM_RULE`, `ATTENDANCE_GUEST_SEARCH_MIN_LENGTH`, `ATTENDANCE_GUEST_SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS`. **Test gotcha:** active members need a `UserStatusChangeFactory(status="active", start<=event.date<=end)`; the scribe user gets NO active status so `active_count` = only the seeded members; use `_make_scribe` (officer group, remove natoff, current_roles=["scribe"]) + `auto_login_user(user=scribe)`. 28 tests (9 model, 19 view) all pass — one per acceptance criterion across WI-3..WI-6.

- **Attendance/Events UX round (2026-07-10):** (1) **Non-enumerable event update URL** — `events:update` changed from `update/<int:pk>/` to `~<int:year>/<int:month>/<int:day>/<slug:event_slug>/edit/` (kwarg is **`event_slug`** NOT `slug`, to avoid colliding with `TypeFieldFilteredChapterAdd.get_form`'s ScoreType-`slug` logic). New `Event.get_update_url()` (mirrors `get_absolute_url`); `EventUpdateView.get_object` resolves by date+event_slug `.order_by("pk").first()` (Http404). `EventTable.name` links to the **detail** page via `Column(linkify=lambda record: record.get_absolute_url())` (updated 2026-07-10 from get_update_url per request "all event tables link first to details"); `render_parent_event` and the sub-event tables in [event_detail.html](thetatauCMT/templates/events/event_detail.html)/[event_form.html](thetatauCMT/templates/events/event_form.html) also link child/parent events to `get_absolute_url` (detail). Edit buttons + the update form `action` still use `get_update_url`. Test `test_event_table_name_links_to_detail` locks this in (`EventTable(data=[event]).rows[0].get_cell("name")` contains `href="{get_absolute_url}"`, not the update URL). **Fixed a latent bug:** [ballots/ballot_form.html](thetatauCMT/templates/ballots/ballot_form.html) (the DEFAULT template for `BallotUpdateView`, which has no `template_name_suffix`) referenced an undefined `event` + `events:update event.id` → now posts to `action=""` and shows `{{ object.name }}`. (2) Attendance link + "Event details" link added to the update page ([event_form.html](thetatauCMT/templates/events/event_form.html), officer-gated). (3) **Create → "Create & Add Attendance"** button (`name="add_attendance"`) on [event_create_form.html](thetatauCMT/templates/events/event_create_form.html); `EventCreateView.forms_valid` redirects to `attendance:roster` when present. (4) **Guest section is now multi-row** ([roster.html](thetatauCMT/templates/attendance/roster.html)): a `<template id="guest-row-template">` cloned by "Add guest", per-row Remove, single "Submit Guests" (disabled until ≥1 selected). `AttendanceGuestAddView.post` now loops `request.POST.getlist("member")` (single value still works). (5) **Roster table**: split First Name / Last Name columns (removed Badge), default sorted by first name (server: `roster.sort(key=first_name,last_name)`), client-side sortable via `id="roster-table"` + `th.sortable`/`th.no-sort` vanilla-JS sorter. (6) Quorum note softened to "If quorum is needed…" (neutral `alert-secondary`, not success/warning). (7) Roster page has an "Event details" link (`event.get_absolute_url`). [attendance/urls.py](thetatauCMT/attendance/urls.py) uses `_EVENT = "~<int:year>/<int:month>/<int:day>/<slug:event_slug>/"` base for roster/save/update/rollup/guest (guest-autocomplete unchanged).
