- **Attendance WI-7 — national bulk upload + matching (2026-07-10):** CSV bulk attendance for NATIONAL events (chapter=None, span chapters). Rows often have only email/name (no member id). **New model** `MatchQueueItem` ([attendance/models.py](thetatauCMT/attendance/models.py), migration `0003_matchqueueitem`): raw_* identity fields, `upload_id` UUID, `fingerprint` (sha256[:64] of raw identity), `candidates` JSON (ranked w/ scores+reasons), `best_score`, `target_status`, `status`(pending/resolved/skipped), resolved_user/attendance_record/resolved_by/resolved_at/uploaded_by. Methods `resolve_to(user, resolved_by, status=None)` (calls `record_attendance` → idempotent upsert, marks RESOLVED) and `skip(resolved_by, note)`. **Matcher** [attendance/matching.py](thetatauCMT/attendance/matching.py): `match_row(row, threshold=None)` → `MatchResult(user, score, tier, auto_accept, candidates)`. Priority id(pk|badge)=1.0 → exact email(iexact email|email_school)=0.95 → name(difflib SequenceMatcher, normalized, best of full-name vs first+last, token-sorted). **Scoring** `confidence = name_sim*0.70 + (0.15 if grad_year matches) + (0.15 if chapter matches)` (weights sum 1.0). Auto-accept only when score **strictly > threshold** (`settings.ATTENDANCE_MATCH_AUTO_ACCEPT_THRESHOLD` default 0.60) AND unambiguous (runner-up not within AMBIGUITY_MARGIN=0.05). Name candidate pool filters by resolved chapter + token `icontains` (cap 200) — **NOTE: misspelled tokens won't surface a candidate (icontains substring)**, so low-confidence tests use a *partial* name (e.g. first name only "Zylphia") not a misspelling. **Parser** [attendance/upload.py](thetatauCMT/attendance/upload.py): `parse_rows(bytes)` (header alias map → canonical keys member_id/badge_number/email/name/first_name/last_name/chapter/graduation_year), `row_fingerprint(row)`, `ingest_attendance_csv(event, file_bytes, uploaded_by, default_status, threshold)` → `UploadResult(total/auto_matched/updated/queued/skipped/errors)`. **Idempotent**: auto rows use `record_attendance` upsert (unique event,user); queue rows `get_or_create(event, fingerprint, status=PENDING)` (dup→refresh candidates+skip); resolved fingerprint→skip. **Views** ([attendance/views.py](thetatauCMT/attendance/views.py), `NationalOfficerRequiredMixin(LoginRequiredMixin)` via `core.models.user_is_national_officer`, redirect `events:list`): `NationalAttendanceUploadView` (GET form/POST ingest), `MatchQueueListView` (`?event=<pk>` filter), `MatchQueueResolveView` (POST item/action=resolve|skip/user_id/status/event), `NationalMemberAutocompleteView` (natoff cross-chapter search). **Form** [attendance/forms.py](thetatauCMT/attendance/forms.py) `NationalAttendanceUploadForm` (event=`Event.objects.national()`, file .csv ≤5MB, default_status). **URLs** `attendance:national_upload|match_queue|match_queue_resolve|national-member-autocomplete` (all `national/...`, before `_EVENT`). Admin `MatchQueueItemAdmin` (+`mark_skipped` action). Templates [national_upload.html](thetatauCMT/templates/attendance/national_upload.html), [match_queue.html](thetatauCMT/templates/attendance/match_queue.html) (candidate radios + JS member search + skip). Nav: 2 links in base.html national dropdown. Settings: `ATTENDANCE_MATCH_AUTO_ACCEPT_THRESHOLD`. **Test gotcha:** national event = `EventFactory.create(chapter=None, is_national=True, type=_evt_score_type(), date=EVENT_DATE)`; natoff = UserFactory + add "natoff" group; view tests use `auto_login_user(user=natoff)` (creates RMP). 18 tests in [attendance/tests/test_upload.py](thetatauCMT/attendance/tests/test_upload.py). Full attendance(47)+events(35)=82 pass.

- **Attendance WI-10 — public events calendar + cross-chapter RSVP (2026-07-11):** **RSVP decision (recommended+built):** an RSVP is a `signed_up` AttendanceRecord (NO new model) — reuses WI-4 lifecycle + snapshot fields + WI-6 privacy (member only ever writes/reads own record). **Services** ([attendance/services.py](thetatauCMT/attendance/services.py)): `can_rsvp(user, event)` = authed + `event.date >= timezone.localdate()` (past events can't sign up, only officers add attended) + `Event.objects.visible_to_chapter(user.current_chapter).filter(pk).exists()` (WI-2); `rsvp_to_event(event, member)` = don't downgrade an existing `attended`, else `record_attendance(status=SIGNED_UP, recorded_by=member)`. **Model** `Event.get_rsvp_url()` (reverse `attendance:rsvp`, date+slug). **RSVP view** `EventRSVPView(LoginRequiredMixin, View)` ([attendance/views.py](thetatauCMT/attendance/views.py)) POST `_lookup_event`→can_rsvp→rsvp_to_event→safe-next/`event.get_absolute_url`. URL `attendance:rsvp` = `_EVENT + "rsvp/"` (member-accessible, NOT under AttendancePermissionMixin). **Calendar** `EventCalendarView(LoginRequiredMixin, TemplateView)` ([events/views.py](thetatauCMT/events/views.py)) at `events:calendar` (URL added before `~<int:year>` detail): base `Event.objects.visible_to_chapter(user.current_chapter)`; `?region=`→chapter__region__slug, `?chapter=`→chapter__slug, `?month=YYYY-MM` (default current), `?view=table|calendar`; month grid via `calendar.Calendar(firstweekday=6).monthdatescalendar` keyed by date; per-event `my_status`/`my_status_display`/`member_can_rsvp`; context `weeks/events/regions/chapters/selected_*/prev_month/next_month`. Template [events/event_calendar.html](thetatauCMT/templates/events/event_calendar.html) (region/chapter selects auto-submit, month nav, grid+table toggle, RSVP `<form>` POST get_rsvp_url + hidden next). **Privacy (WI-6):** `EventDetailView` now sets `can_view_attendance` = `can_record_attendance(user,event)` OR same-chapter member; [event_detail.html](thetatauCMT/templates/events/event_detail.html) gates the roster table behind it (cross-chapter viewers see "roster only visible to chapter officers") + adds an RSVP button (`can_rsvp`, `my_rsvp_status`). **Chapter detail** ([chapters/views.py](thetatauCMT/chapters/views.py) `ChapterDetailView`) adds `public_events` = `Event.objects.cross_chapter_visible().filter(chapter=chapter, date__gte=localdate())`; new "Public Events" accordion in [chapter_detail.html](thetatauCMT/templates/chapters/chapter_detail.html) with RSVP buttons. Nav/filter links dropped the `view` param (localStorage carries it). 6 new tests (columns reduced, own/other profile cancel, calendar selectors+both-views+Today). events+attendance: 162 pass, only pre-existing flaky fails.

- **iCal subscription feeds (2026-07-12, django-ical):** Members subscribe their calendar app (Google/Outlook/Apple) to private, token-scoped `.ics` URLs. Package `django-ical==1.9.2` added to [requirements/base.txt](requirements/base.txt) (pulls django-recurrence 1.14 + icalendar 7.2.0; **views-only lib, NOT in INSTALLED_APPS**). **Model** `CalendarFeedSubscription(TimeStampedModel)` in [events/models.py](thetatauCMT/events/models.py) (migration `0010_calendarfeedsubscription`): `token`=UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, unique, editable=False, db_index — unguessable so the feed can't be scraped by id enumeration), `user` FK(related_name="calendar_feeds"), `name`, `include_national`(default True), `include_todos`(default False), `chapters` M2M(Chapter), `regions` M2M(regions.Region). `get_feed_path()`→`reverse("events:ical", {token})`. `events_queryset(start_date=None)` builds an OR-scope Q (empty `Q(pk__in=[])` seed; `|= Q(is_national=True)` if national; `|= Q(chapter_id__in=...) & approved_public` and `|= Q(chapter__region_id__in=...) & approved_public` where `approved_public = Q(is_public=True, approval_status=APPROVED)`) then `.filter(date__gte=start_date).distinct()` — **only ever exposes cross-chapter-visible content** (WI-2 rule; pending/rejected/private excluded; national needs no approval). Default `start_date = localdate() - timedelta(weeks=ICAL_FEED_PAST_WEEKS)` (module const =4) — the **date-limit** requirement (recent past + all future). `todos_queryset(start_date=None)` returns None unless `include_todos` AND `user.current_chapter`; else `TaskDate.incomplete_dates_for_chapter(chapter).filter(date__gte=start_date)` (lazy `from thetatauCMT.tasks.models import TaskDate`). **Feed** [events/feeds.py](thetatauCMT/events/feeds.py): `SubscriptionICalFeed(ICalFeed)` (`from django_ical.views import ICalFeed`), `@method_decorator(cache_page(60*15), name="__call__")` (**caching** requirement — `__call__` IS the view; unique token per feed → no cross-test LocMemCache collision), `product_id`, `timezone="UTC"`, `get_object(request, token)`=`CalendarFeedSubscription.objects.get(token=token)` (DoesNotExist→404), `items(obj)` wraps events+todos in `_FeedItem(kind, obj)` (`__slots__`). **django-ical VTODO** (the "Todos feed" requirement) is native: `item_component_type`→"todo" makes `feedgenerator.ICal20Feed.write_items` emit `BEGIN:VTODO` (else VEVENT). item_* methods: `item_guid`=`f"{kind}-{pk}@cmt.thetatau.org"`, `item_title` (todo→`"To-do: {task.name}"` else event.name), `item_start_datetime` (event→`date` → all-day DTSTART;VALUE=DATE; todo→None), `item_end_datetime` (event→date+1d), `item_due` (todo→date), `item_link` (todo→`reverse("tasks:list")` else `event.get_absolute_url()`). `feeds.py` imports `from django.utils import timezone as tz` (avoid clash w/ the `timezone` field). **Form** `CalendarFeedSubscriptionForm(ModelForm)` [events/forms.py](thetatauCMT/events/forms.py): fields name/include_national/include_todos/regions/chapters; regions=`CheckboxSelectMultiple`, chapters=`autocomplete.ModelSelect2Multiple(url="events:chapter-feed-autocomplete")` (**DAL widget at CLASS level**, set `.queryset`+required in `__init__` — see WI-8 gotcha); adds Bootstrap classes via `widget.attrs.setdefault`. **Views** [events/views.py](thetatauCMT/events/views.py): `ChapterFeedAutocomplete(Select2QuerySetView)` (auth-gated active chapters by name), `CalendarFeedListView(LoginRequiredMixin, View)` (GET list `request.user.calendar_feeds`+blank form; POST create with `user=request.user`, redirect `#feed-<pk>`), `ChapterFeedSubscribeView(LoginRequiredMixin, View)` (POST chapter slug → get-or-create a `"<Chapter> public events"` feed scoped to that one chapter, **idempotent** by (user,name)), `CalendarFeedDeleteView(LoginRequiredMixin, View)` (POST, **user-scoped** `filter(pk, user=request.user)` so members can't delete others' feeds). **URLs** [events/urls.py](thetatauCMT/events/urls.py) (`from . import feeds, views`): `ical/<uuid:token>/`→`feeds.SubscriptionICalFeed()` name `ical` (NOTE: feed instance, not `.as_view()`), `feeds/` name `feeds`, `feeds/subscribe-chapter/` name `feed_subscribe_chapter`, `feeds/<int:pk>/delete/` name `feed_delete`, `chapter-feed-autocomplete/`. **The ical feed URL is intentionally NOT login-required** — calendar apps fetch with no session; the unguessable token is the credential. **UI** (both requirements): (a) [templates/events/calendar_feeds.html](thetatauCMT/templates/events/calendar_feeds.html) (new) lists feeds w/ https URL (readonly input + `.clipboard` copy button using `data-clipboard-text` — project.js wires ClipboardJS+tooltip globally) + `webcal://` "Add to calendar" link + delete form; plus the create form w/ `{{ form.media }}`; (b) calendar page ([event_calendar.html](thetatauCMT/templates/events/event_calendar.html)) got a green **Subscribe** button in the header opening `#subscribeModal` (Bootstrap modal w/ the same form POSTing to `events:feeds`; `EventCalendarView.get_context_data` provides `feed_form`; `{{ feed_form.media }}` after the modal); (c) chapter detail Public Events accordion ([chapter_detail.html](thetatauCMT/templates/chapters/chapter_detail.html)) got a "Subscribe to these events" button (POST `events:feed_subscribe_chapter` w/ hidden `chapter=object.slug`, `{% if user.is_authenticated %}`). **Tests** [events/tests/test_ical.py](thetatauCMT/events/tests/test_ical.py) (12, all pass): bad token→404, feed reachable w/o login, approved-public+national only (pending/rejected/private excluded), chapter scope, region scope, date-window (old >4wk excluded), VTODO when opted-in + user has chapter, no VTODO when off, create via form POST, chapter quick-subscribe idempotent, delete own feed, can't delete another's. Test helpers: `_national_event(name)` = `EventFactory.create(chapter=None, is_national=True, type=_evt_type(), ...)`; distinct chapters via `GREEK_ABR.values()`; single GET per token (cache). No regressions — only the 2 documented pre-existing failures remain.

All 18 pass; no new regressions (only the 2 documented pre-existing failures).

- **Clipboard copy buttons rewritten (2026-07-12):** `.clipboard` copy buttons ([static/js/project.js](thetatauCMT/static/js/project.js)) used `new Clipboard('.clipboard', …)` from clipboard.js **v1.5.10, which is only `<script>`-included on a few pages** (chapter_detail, convention_list, osm_list, pledgeprogram_list, officer_list, geararticle_list) — NOT global. On any other page (e.g. the new calendar-feeds page) the global `Clipboard` resolved to the browser's built-in `Clipboard` class → `Uncaught TypeError: Failed to construct 'Clipboard': Illegal constructor` and the button silently did nothing. Rewrote the whole clipboard block to use the **native async Clipboard API** (`navigator.clipboard.writeText` when `window.isSecureContext`, else a `document.execCommand('copy')` textarea fallback) with **per-element** Bootstrap tooltips (the old code keyed tooltips by `clipboardTooltips[this]` — a stringified DOM node → collided on multi-button pages like the feeds page). No library needed now; works on every page. The old per-page clipboard.js CDN `<script>` includes are now dead weight (harmless; my code never touches the global `Clipboard`). Copies `data-clipboard-text` (falls back to `textContent`). **Note:** requires a secure context (HTTPS or localhost) — fine for prod + local dev. Static served from source via finders in DEBUG (no `staticfiles/js/project.js` collected), so no collectstatic; users may need a hard refresh.
- **iCal feed = live subscription, not a download:** the `.ics` URL is a live endpoint; opening it in a browser downloads a one-time snapshot, but pasting it into a calendar app's "subscribe from URL" flow (or clicking the `webcal://` "Add to calendar" button) makes the app re-poll it for new events. The 15-min `cache_page` is well within calendar-app poll intervals. Added a "How to subscribe (Google/Apple/Outlook)" `<details>` help block to [calendar_feeds.html](thetatauCMT/templates/events/calendar_feeds.html); the raw https URL is shown in a readonly input (Copy button) — intentionally NOT a hyperlink — while the clickable action is the `webcal://` link.

- **Scores app review + fixes (2026-07-12):** Reviewed biennium scoring. **System:** `ScoreType` (points=max/acad-year, term_points=max/term, type Evt/Sub/Spe, `special`=eval formula); `ScoreChapter(YearTermModel)` = (chapter,type,year,term)->score. Event/Submission `.save(calculate_score=True)` -> `type.calculate_score(obj)`->obj.score then `type.update_chapter_score(chapter,date)`. `chapter_score(chapter,date)`=Sum(event.score) in semester window, min(total,term_points). `update_chapter_score` pairs a Fall term with the FOLLOWING Spring (=1 acad year) and caps fall+spring at `points` (Fall kept whole, Spring=remainder; self-consistent b/c chapter_score re-derives from events). `annotate_chapter_score` maps ScoreChapter rows to 4 biennium slots: score1=Fall Y0, score2=Spring Y1, score3=Fall Y1, score4=Spring Y2. **BUGS FIXED:** (1) **Boundary off-by-one** — `chapter_events`/`chapter_submissions` used `date__gt`/`date__lt` (exclusive both ends) w/ `YearTermModel.date_range()`=(Jul1,Jan1)/(Jan1,Jul1), so events on exactly Jul1/Jan1 scored in NEITHER semester (dead zone). Fixed to half-open `date__gte`/`date__lt`. (2) **Window inconsistency** — `Event.calculate_meeting_attendance` ([events/models.py](thetatauCMT/events/models.py)) used `semester_encompass_start_end_date` (inclusive) while scoring used `date_range` (exclusive); aligned it to `YearTermModel.date_range` + `date__gte`/`date__lt` (added `YearTermModel` to its core.models import; `semester_encompass_start_end_date` still used at L408 `count_events_biennium`). (3) **service-hours wiped to 0 (BIG)** — `score_calculate_extras` command computes service-hours (fixture pk13, **type Evt** w/ special `50*(HOURS/(MEMBERS*16))` → events always score 0 since HOURS/MEMBERS are in `calculate_special`'s `calcualted_elsewhere`) from `UserSemesterServiceHours`, but its end-of-year "recompute all Evt/Sub" loop then summed the zero-scored events and OVERWROTE it to 0. Fixed by excluding `COMMAND_COMPUTED_SLUGS=[pledge-ratio,membership,service-hours,gpa,societies]` from that final loop. **SIMPLIFIED:** `annotate_chapter_score` rewritten (single query + `defaultdict` + explicit `biennium_slots` dict; was N+1 `scores_values.filter(id=..)` in a loop + confusing offset math; output identical); `update_chapter_score` cap block rewritten to explicit fall/spring + `max(0,...)` (same behavior, clearer, can't go negative); `ScoreChapter.update_score` now delegates to `update_chapter_score` (single code path w/ year cap). **Tests:** +6 in [scores/tests/test_models.py](thetatauCMT/scores/tests/test_models.py) (jan/jul boundary counted, year-cap keeps-fall-whole x2, biennium slot map, neighboring-biennia ignored; `_clean_type()` helper clears leaked events/scorechapters for --reuse-db isolation) + new [scores/tests/test_commands.py](thetatauCMT/scores/tests/test_commands.py) (service-hours not wiped; verified it fails `assert 0.0>0` without the command fix). **NOT fixed (out of scope, documented):** `count_events_biennium` ([events/models.py](thetatauCMT/events/models.py) L404) has an undefined-`query` bug when a `date` is passed (`cls.objects.filter(...)` result not assigned) — pre-existing, unrelated to scoring; no Event/Submission delete recalculation (no UI delete views, admin-only); command min() caps vs fixture term_points mismatches (e.g. societies min20 vs term_points10) are domain config. **Full suite after: 1631 pass, 17 skip, 0 fail (~96s).** `eval()` in `calculate_special` is admin-controlled DB formulas (existing).

- **Event soft-delete (2026-07-14):** Chapter officers can soft-delete events (with a confirmation page); soft-deleted events drop out of scoring and every listing. **Model** ([events/models.py](thetatauCMT/events/models.py)): `Event.deleted` (BooleanField default False, db_index), `deleted_at`, `deleted_by` (FK user SET_NULL, related_name="events_deleted") — migration `0012_alter_event_options_alter_event_managers_and_more` (also records the manager/options change; harmless). **Manager split (the key mechanism):** `EventManager` (default `objects`) overrides `get_queryset()` → `.filter(deleted=False)`, so `Event.objects` AND reverse relations `chapter.events` / `type.events` (used by `ScoreType.chapter_events` → scoring) automatically exclude soft-deleted rows. `AllEventManager` (`all_objects`) is unfiltered. `Meta.base_manager_name = "all_objects"` (so cascade deletes, forward-FK access like `AttendanceRecord.event`, and `refresh_from_db` still see deleted rows) + `default_manager_name = "objects"`. `EventQuerySet` gained `.alive()` / `.dead()`. Both managers are `Manager.from_queryset(EventQuerySet)` subclasses (via `_EventQuerySetManager`). Model methods: `soft_delete(user)` (sets flags, `save(calculate_score=False)`, then `type.update_chapter_score(chapter, date)` so the term aggregate drops the event's points), `restore(user)` (mirror), `get_delete_url()` (non-enumerable date+slug → `events:delete`). **Permission** module fn `can_delete_event(user, event)`: superuser OR `is_national_officer_group` OR (`is_chapter_officer_group` AND `current_chapter.pk == event.chapter_id`). National events (chapter=None) → only natoff/superuser. **View** `EventDeleteView(LoginRequiredMixin, View)` ([events/views.py](thetatauCMT/events/views.py)): `dispatch` lets LoginRequiredMixin handle anon first, then `_get_event` (date+slug via `Event.objects`, 404) + `can_delete_event` guard (else message + redirect to `get_absolute_url`); GET renders `events/event_confirm_delete.html`; POST calls `soft_delete` + `_safe_next(request, reverse("events:list"))`. URL `~<int:year>/<int:month>/<int:day>/<slug:event_slug>/delete/` name `delete` (before the detail catch-all). `EventDetailView` + `EventUpdateView` context gained `can_delete = can_delete_event(user, object)`; a red "Delete" button (gated on `can_delete`) added to [event_detail.html](thetatauCMT/templates/events/event_detail.html) page-actions and [event_form.html](thetatauCMT/templates/events/event_form.html). **Admin** ([events/admin.py](thetatauCMT/events/admin.py)): `get_queryset` → `all_objects` (shows deleted), `deleted` added to list_display + list_filter, `deleted_at`/`deleted_by` readonly, `soft_delete_events`/`restore_events` actions. **Not changed:** attendance history (`member_attendance` queries AttendanceRecord and forward-FK `event` uses base_manager, so a member's record of a later-deleted event still shows — intentional, it's their record); `unique_together=(name,date,chapter)` still counts soft-deleted rows (recreating same name/date/chapter hits the existing IntegrityError-friendly message). **Tests** [events/tests/test_soft_delete.py](thetatauCMT/events/tests/test_soft_delete.py) (8): GET confirmation doesn't delete, chapter officer can delete (deleted_by set), regular member can't (redirect to detail, still exists), other-chapter officer can't, natoff can, hidden from default + reverse managers (`chapter.events`/`type.events`), removed from scoring (delta on `type.chapter_events().aggregate(Sum(score))`), restore. Test scoring uses `Event.all_objects.filter(pk).update(score=…)` + `refresh_from_db()` before `soft_delete` (soft_delete saves the full instance, so refresh first to avoid clobbering score). All 8 pass; events+attendance+scores+chapters-views = 243 pass, 0 fail (even the 2 usually-flaky pre-existing tests passed this run).
